steps.input: entry = await rlm.harness.create_memory(title="ARC: extend solid rectangle away from marker dots", content="For ARC tasks with a solid rectangular block of color 2 and isolated same-color marker dots (e.g. 1/3/8), extend the rectangle's rows/columns to grid edges, preserving dots. In each block row, extend horizontally to an edge unless a marker lies beyond that edge on the same row; a marker on one side suppresses extension toward that marker but the opposite side still extends. If there is no aligned marker, extend both ways. Likewise, for each block column, extend vertically toward each edge unless a marker lies beyond that edge in the same column. Thus aligned markers carve gaps in their directional rays; unmarked lines extend fully. Keep original markers intact and leave unrelated cells unchanged.", path="arc-patterns", global_=True); entry
